question: The Brihadeshwara Temple at Thanjavur was built by which of these rulers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raja Raja Chola I**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raja Raja Chola I** was a renowned ruler of the **Chola dynasty** in South India.
 
• The **Brihadeshwara Temple** at Thanjavur, also known as the **Peruvudaiyar Kovil**, was commissioned and constructed by him.
 
• This temple is a part of the **Great Living Chola Temples**, a UNESCO **World Heritage Site**.
 
• It was built between **1003 and 1010 AD** and is dedicated to **Lord Shiva**.
 
• The temple is known for its massive **vimana (temple tower)**, which is one of the tallest in the world.
 
• The architecture of the temple reflects the **Dravidian style** and showcases the grandeur of the Chola empire.
 
• Raja Raja Chola I's reign is often considered the **golden age** of the Chola dynasty, marked by extensive territorial expansion and patronage of art and architecture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rajadhiraja Chola II**__

 __
 
• Rajadhiraja Chola II was another ruler of the **Chola dynasty**, but his reign came much later than that of Raja Raja Chola I.
 
• He ruled in the latter half of the 12th century.
 
 
 
• **Raja Raja Chola III**__
 __
 
• Raja Raja Chola III also belonged to the **Chola dynasty** and ruled during the 13th century.
 
• His reign was marked by internal strife and challenges to Chola authority.
 
 
 
• **Rajendra Chola III**__
 
 
• Rajendra Chola III was one of the last rulers of the **Chola dynasty**.
 
• His reign marked the decline of Chola power in the region, culminating in their eventual subjugation by the Pandyas.
